aspects.says: A translation between the standards is a field-by-field mapping agreed with the other party, because the packager refuses what doesn't fit and one side lacks data the other expects.
basis: section:16.5. A Bridge Between the Standards Decides, Field by Field, What the Other Side Lacks

aspects.says: ISO 20022 defines messages from a business model and carries account-to-account payments, while card authorization between acquirers, networks and issuers stays on ISO 8583.
basis: section:16.4. ISO 20022 Models the Business First, and It Carries Account-to-Account Payments

aspects.says: In JSON every field value travels as an escaped string and binary fields as hex, because numbers lose leading zeros and bytes put in as text are corrupted.
basis: section:16.2. JSON Has No Type for Fixed-Width Text or Raw Bytes

aspects.says: A new syntax is a packager paired with a channel that frames it, and the messages keep their flows: an unanswered request is still reversed, whatever the syntax.
basis: section:16.1. Another Syntax Changes the Packager, Not the Messages

aspects.says: XML from a peer is parsed with DOCTYPE declarations and external entities refused; XML2003Packager in 2.1.7 resolves them and can read a local file into a field.
basis: section:16.3. An XML Parser That Accepts a DOCTYPE Reads Files for the Sender
